questions.stem: What is the difference between a habitat and a community?

options.text: A habitat is where an organism lives; a community is all the different species living in that habitat
A community is a single species; a habitat is multiple species
A habitat is the food an organism eats; a community is where it sleeps

questions.explanation: A habitat is the place where an organism lives (e.g., a pond). A community is all the populations of different species living and interacting in that habitat.
